name: Agent Skills
desc: Folders of instructions and scripts that teach Claude a task
desc_zh: 用说明和脚本教会 Claude 一类任务的技能包
solves: Every chat repeats the same house style and steps; a Skill saves them once and Claude loads it when needed.
solves_zh: 每次对话都要重复同样的风格和步骤，技能保存一次后按需自动加载。
best_for: Your team writes the same release-note format every sprint and wants Claude to follow it automatically.
best_for_zh: 团队每个迭代都写同一种发布说明格式，希望 Claude 自动照做。
